items.markdown:
When looking for alternatives to **Kosli** —which specializes in lightweight, developer-friendly continuous compliance, artifact tracking, and change attestation for DevOps pipelines—the right choice depends on whether you need end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) governance, native CI/CD compliance features, or software supply chain security and provenance.[[1]](https://www.secureleap.tech/blog/vanta-alternatives)[[2]](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026)

The top alternatives to Kosli are categorized below by their primary strengths:

### 1. End-to-End SDLC Governance & Release Evidence

- **[LoopIQ](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026):** Best if you want to expand compliance beyond just the deployment pipeline into planning, testing, ITSM, and manual approvals. It compiles everything into a "Release Compliance Dossier," making it ideal for regulated teams needing holistic, audit-ready proof across the entire lifecycle.[[1]](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026)

### 2. Native CI/CD & Pipeline Governance Platforms

- **[GitLab Ultimate / Enterprise](https://about.gitlab.com/):** Best for teams looking for an all-in-one DevOps platform. GitLab includes built-in compliance frameworks, separation-of-duties approval rules, merge request approvals, and audit events natively inside the CI/CD pipeline.[[1]](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026)
- **[Harness](https://www.harness.io/):** Best if your primary focus is continuous delivery (CD) combined with robust policy-as-code. Harness features governance workflows, approval guardrails, and compliance checks embedded directly into deployment stages.[[1]](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026)

### 3. Artifact Provenance & Supply Chain Security

- **Sigstore & Trivy (Open Source):** If you lean toward open-source tooling for software bill of materials (SBOM) generation and cryptographic verification, combining a scanner like **Trivy** with keyless artifact signing via **Sigstore** allows you to track and verify provenance natively without an independent commercial control plane.[[1]](https://www.upwind.io/glossary/13-best-devsecops-tools-2025s-best-open-source-options-sorted-by-use-case)[[2]](https://www.secureleap.tech/blog/vanta-alternatives)
- **Cloudsmith:** An artifact-centric repository platform that provides strong supply chain provenance, upstream proxying, and multi-format package management with native security auditing.[[1]](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026)

### 4. Broad GRC & Security Compliance Platforms

- **Hyperproof / Strike Graph:** If your primary pain point with Kosli was satisfying non-technical auditors or GRC teams, traditional compliance operations (SecOps/GRC) platforms map controls directly to frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA, automating the collection of evidence across your tech stack.[[1]](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/kosli/alternatives)[[2]](https://www.secureleap.tech/blog/vanta-alternatives)[[3]](https://www.loopiqblogs.com/post/best-kosli-alternatives-for-sdlc-governance-in-2026)

If you want to narrow down the right option, let me know:

- Are you trying to solve a **strict audit/compliance requirement** (like SOC 2 or FDA/ISO)?
- Do you want something **tightly integrated into your existing CI/CD** (like GitHub/GitLab), or a **standalone dashboard**?
